answer: Link every identity to a distinct funding trail: each new account must lock a small refundable bond paid from its own payment source, and accounts whose bonds trace back to the same source are treated as one operator. If one clone misbehaves, the whole cluster's bonds are slashed, so a farmer risks real money on every fake. Honest users arrive through unrelated sources, while a farm betrays itself as a vine of transfers branching from a single root. The delta is visible in the money graph, which auditors sweep each epoch like wind reshaping a dune, pruning linked clusters before they can vote.
